description: Angular component for breadcrumb navigation in the Thingsboard UI, managing breadcrumb trail updates based on route changes and active component.

classes.name: BreadcrumbComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing breadcrumb navigation with dynamic updates based on route and active component changes.

methods.name: setActiveComponent
methods.description: Sets the active component and subscribes to its breadcrumb update events.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up event listeners, and retrieves the current active component.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: lastChild
methods.description: Finds the last child route in the route snapshot.

methods.name: buildBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Constructs the breadcrumb trail based on the current route and available menu sections.

methods.name: trackByBreadcrumbs
methods.description: Track function for breadcrumb list rendering optimization.
